description: In every equality-axiom model \(N\), an original native clause formula holds at \(q\circ u\) in its specified quotient if and only if the actual translated shared relation-clause formula holds at \(u\) in \(N\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.originalClause_quotient_truth.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type w} {N : Type z} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N]
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Axioms L N)
  (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.OriginalClause L α) (v : α → N) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.originalClauseFormula C).Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.projection h ∘ v) ↔
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseToFormula
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.translateClause C)).Realize
      v
